title: Carbon-footprint social diagram
slide_intent: Organize a broad responsibility message into small actions so readers can see possible points of participation.
strategic_value: The diagram can connect Sweetgreen’s environmental stance to everyday choices in a social format.
demonstration: A phone placed over corn shows a social post with looping connections around a central Ways to lower your carbon footprint message.
practical_value: Assess how a dense informational diagram reads within a social-feed frame before relying on it for detailed instruction.

content_islands.name: Phone and post
content_islands.spec: Center the phone, preserving the diagram and surrounding social interface.

content_islands.name: Corn surround
content_islands.spec: Fill the background with close-up corn to retain the food context.

reference_purposes.Application: An environmental-information diagram is shown as a social post.
reference_purposes.Expression: Fine looping lines and a bright central field organize the message.
